conclusion: The port registers the boundary frame 4497 with gcorrs=9, raw inliers=9 and unique 3D points=9 (no rig FoV duplicates), max reprojection 9.22 px <= 12 px. The unique-3D-point support equals the raw count, so COLMAP's UniqueInlierSupportMeasurer would also count 9 and accept at abs_pose_min_num_inliers=8. The earlier unique-support hypothesis is therefore rejected, and this matches the direct experiment (implementing unique support changed neither the merge nor improved 10k; it regressed 10k to ATE 12.70). Since COLMAP's model0 stops after frame 4493 with the same ~8 visible points visible in image 9497, the divergence is in the generalized absolute-pose estimator/refinement itself: COLMAP's EstimateGeneralizedAbsolutePose (RANSAC) + RefineGeneralizedAbsolutePose (Ceres) must fail for this near-degenerate 9-correspondence pose (or its correspondence set differs) where the port's GeneralizedPnPRansac + Gauss-Newton refiner succeeds.
method: Env-gated VSLOC_DEBUG_REGISTER_FRAMES logging added to IncrementalMapper::register_next_general_frame; ran the 10k COLMAP-verified graph and captured the boundary registrations.
